prompts.raw:
You are a professional screenplay analyst. Extract scene-level metadata from the following scene excerpt.

Return a JSON object with these fields:
- heading: The scene heading in standard format (e.g., "INT. OFFICE - DAY"). Infer from context if not explicitly stated.
- location: The location name (without INT/EXT and time of day)
- time_of_day: e.g., "DAY", "NIGHT", "DAWN", "CONTINUOUS". Infer from context clues.
- int_ext: One of "INT", "EXT", or "INT/EXT"
- characters_present: Array of character names who appear or speak in this scene
- narrative_beats: Array of objects, each with:
  - beat_type: e.g., "character_introduction", "revelation", "conflict", "comic_relief", "thematic_statement", "action", "foreshadowing", "character_development"
  - description: 1-2 sentence description of the beat
  - confidence: float 0-1
- tone_mood: Overall tone/mood of the scene (e.g., "tense", "warm", "dark comedy")
- tone_shifts: Array of tone changes within the scene (e.g., ["tense to comic relief", "comic relief to conflict"])

Important:
- Infer location and time from context if not given as a heading
- Identify ALL characters who speak or are described, including those referred to by name
- Narrative beats should capture key story moments, not just action descriptions
- Be specific about tone — "dark comedy" is better than "mixed"

Return ONLY valid JSON. No explanations or markdown fences.

==========
SCENE EXCERPT:
{{scene_text}}
==========

  - confidence: float 0-1

Important:
- Infer location and time from context if not given as a heading
- Identify ALL characters who speak or are described, including those referred to by name
- Narrative beats should capture key story moments, not just action descriptions
- Be specific about tone — "dark comedy" is better than "mixed"

Return ONLY valid JSON. No explanations or markdown fences.

==========
SCENE EXCERPT:
INT. RUDDY & GREEN BUILDING - ELEVATOR

UB40's "I Can't Help Falling in Love With You" muzak.

ROSE (mid-30s) leans against the elevator wall, panting. She’s wearing a Tim Hortons uniform, her hair is a mess, and there’s blood spattered on her face.

She looks right, pants a few more times, then squints in disgust. She gingerly picks up a bloody scrap of something with hair on it. She snorts and drops it.

ROSE
Is that skull??

Next to her is Mariner, also panting, covered in far more blood. His face is broad, stoic, and frowning. He has gray-blue eyes and a thick, curly, beard barely streaked with gray. He wears a red knit cap and a small mask.

FULL-SCREEN SUPERIMPOSED TITLE CARD: "THE MARINER"

He blinks a few times as a drop of blood falls from his eyebrow. He looks toward her, then spits out some blood.

MARINER
Yeaaaaah...

He’s built like a pro-wrestler. Moss green SWEATER stretched over his huge frame, sleeves rolled showing heavy leather BRACERS adorned with anchors. His inner forearm has a classic heart-and-arrow TATTOO with "Dad" in the centre. Across his chest is a BANDOLIER of bright red 12-gauge shells, FISH HOOKS hanging from the bottom edge. Heavy rubberized BOOTS go past his knees. A CAPE of heavy FISHING NET edged with WEIGHTS hangs from his shoulders.

He holds a STOUT WOODEN OAR in both hands, edged with METAL and dripping with BLOOD. He shakes it to dislodge another GRISLY BIT which hits the ground with a wet plop.

ROSE
How the hell did you find me?

Mariner looks down and mumbles something.

ROSE
(annoyed)
What?

MARINER
AirTag.

ROSE
What??

MARINER
I stashed an AirTag in your purse. Last Thanksgiving at ma’s.

ROSE
Shit! My purse!

MARINER
Just in case! I worry about--

ROSE
Shut it! We gotta go back for it.

MARINER
What? No way! I’m taking you home. It’s my fault they went after you. I never thought they’d--

ROSE
(laughing)
You think they’re after you?

Mariner looks confused. DING - elevator doors open on 12.

Three THUGS are waiting for them. THUG 1 raises his GUN... Mariner SWINGS HIS OAR in an arc, catching the gun... BANG - shot goes high, GUN FLIES out of his hand... Mariner SIDE-KICKS him in the chest... Thug 1 FLIES back, knocking the others to the GROUND.

Rose has been frantically pressing the CLOSE DOOR button.

The thugs struggle to their feet.

THUG 2
(into radio)
We’ve got them on twelve.

THUGS 2 & 3 DRAW GUNS. BLAM BLAM BLAM. Rose and Mariner LEAP to the side... DOORS begin to CLOSE... Thug 2 LUNGES at the elevator BUTTON... Mariner’s OAR flashes through the closing doors... Thug 2 SCREAMS and CURSES... Doors close.

THUG
(muffled)
Go! Go! Down to eight!

Rose presses 11.

ROSE
We’ll take the stairs up. They won’t expect that.

MARINER
Because it’s stupid!

Rose raises an eyebrow at Mariner’s crazy outfit.

MARINER
It’s functional! ... And an homage.

prompt.raw:
You are a professional screenplay analyst. Extract scene-level metadata from the following scene excerpt.

Return a JSON object with these fields:
- heading: The scene heading in standard format (e.g., "INT. OFFICE - DAY"). Infer from context if not explicitly stated.
- location: The location name (without INT/EXT and time of day)
- time_of_day: e.g., "DAY", "NIGHT", "DAWN", "CONTINUOUS". Infer from context clues.
- int_ext: One of "INT", "EXT", or "INT/EXT"
- characters_present: Array of character names who appear or speak in this scene
- narrative_beats: Array of objects, each with:
  - beat_type: e.g., "character_introduction", "revelation", "conflict", "comic_relief", "thematic_statement", "action", "foreshadowing", "character_development"
  - description: 1-2 sentence description of the beat
  - confidence: float 0-1
- tone_mood: Overall tone/mood of the scene (e.g., "tense", "warm", "dark comedy")
- tone_shifts: Array of tone changes within the scene (e.g., ["tense to comic relief", "comic relief to conflict"])

Important:
- Infer location and time from context if not given as a heading
- Identify ALL characters who speak or are described, including those referred to by name
- Narrative beats should capture key story moments, not just action descriptions
- Be specific about tone — "dark comedy" is better than "mixed"

Return ONLY valid JSON. No explanations or markdown fences.

==========
SCENE EXCERPT:
INT. RUDDY & GREEN BUILDING - ELEVATOR

UB40's "I Can't Help Falling in Love With You" muzak.

ROSE (mid-30s) leans against the elevator wall, panting. She’s wearing a Tim Hortons uniform, her hair is a mess, and there’s blood spattered on her face.

She looks right, pants a few more times, then squints in disgust. She gingerly picks up a bloody scrap of something with hair on it. She snorts and drops it.

ROSE
Is that skull??

Next to her is Mariner, also panting, covered in far more blood. His face is broad, stoic, and frowning. He has gray-blue eyes and a thick, curly, beard barely streaked with gray. He wears a red knit cap and a small mask.

FULL-SCREEN SUPERIMPOSED TITLE CARD: "THE MARINER"

He blinks a few times as a drop of blood falls from his eyebrow. He looks toward her, then spits out some blood.

MARINER
Yeaaaaah...

He’s built like a pro-wrestler. Moss green SWEATER stretched over his huge frame, sleeves rolled showing heavy leather BRACERS adorned with anchors. His inner forearm has a classic heart-and-arrow TATTOO with "Dad" in the centre. Across his chest is a BANDOLIER of bright red 12-gauge shells, FISH HOOKS hanging from the bottom edge. Heavy rubberized BOOTS go past his knees. A CAPE of heavy FISHING NET edged with WEIGHTS hangs from his shoulders.

He holds a STOUT WOODEN OAR in both hands, edged with METAL and dripping with BLOOD. He shakes it to dislodge another GRISLY BIT which hits the ground with a wet plop.

ROSE
How the hell did you find me?

Mariner looks down and mumbles something.

ROSE
(annoyed)
What?

MARINER
AirTag.

ROSE
What??

MARINER
I stashed an AirTag in your purse. Last Thanksgiving at ma’s.

ROSE
Shit! My purse!

MARINER
Just in case! I worry about--

ROSE
Shut it! We gotta go back for it.

MARINER
What? No way! I’m taking you home. It’s my fault they went after you. I never thought they’d--

ROSE
(laughing)
You think they’re after you?

Mariner looks confused. DING - elevator doors open on 12.

Three THUGS are waiting for them. THUG 1 raises his GUN... Mariner SWINGS HIS OAR in an arc, catching the gun... BANG - shot goes high, GUN FLIES out of his hand... Mariner SIDE-KICKS him in the chest... Thug 1 FLIES back, knocking the others to the GROUND.

Rose has been frantically pressing the CLOSE DOOR button.

The thugs struggle to their feet.

THUG 2
(into radio)
We’ve got them on twelve.

THUGS 2 & 3 DRAW GUNS. BLAM BLAM BLAM. Rose and Mariner LEAP to the side... DOORS begin to CLOSE... Thug 2 LUNGES at the elevator BUTTON... Mariner’s OAR flashes through the closing doors... Thug 2 SCREAMS and CURSES... Doors close.

THUG
(muffled)
Go! Go! Down to eight!

Rose presses 11.

ROSE
We’ll take the stairs up. They won’t expect that.

MARINER
Because it’s stupid!

Rose raises an eyebrow at Mariner’s crazy outfit.

MARINER
It’s functional! ... And an homage.
==========

INT. RUDDY & GREEN BUILDING - ELEVATOR

UB40's "I Can't Help Falling in Love With You" muzak.

ROSE (mid-30s) leans against the elevator wall, panting. She’s wearing a Tim Hortons uniform, her hair is a mess, and there’s blood spattered on her face.

She looks right, pants a few more times, then squints in disgust. She gingerly picks up a bloody scrap of something with hair on it. She snorts and drops it.

ROSE
Is that skull??

Next to her is Mariner, also panting, covered in far more blood. His face is broad, stoic, and frowning. He has gray-blue eyes and a thick, curly, beard barely streaked with gray. He wears a red knit cap and a small mask.

FULL-SCREEN SUPERIMPOSED TITLE CARD: "THE MARINER"

He blinks a few times as a drop of blood falls from his eyebrow. He looks toward her, then spits out some blood.

MARINER
Yeaaaaah...

He’s built like a pro-wrestler. Moss green SWEATER stretched over his huge frame, sleeves rolled showing heavy leather BRACERS adorned with anchors. His inner forearm has a classic heart-and-arrow TATTOO with "Dad" in the centre. Across his chest is a BANDOLIER of bright red 12-gauge shells, FISH HOOKS hanging from the bottom edge. Heavy rubberized BOOTS go past his knees. A CAPE of heavy FISHING NET edged with WEIGHTS hangs from his shoulders.

He holds a STOUT WOODEN OAR in both hands, edged with METAL and dripping with BLOOD. He shakes it to dislodge another GRISLY BIT which hits the ground with a wet plop.

ROSE
How the hell did you find me?

Mariner looks down and mumbles something.

ROSE
(annoyed)
What?

MARINER
AirTag.

ROSE
What??

MARINER
I stashed an AirTag in your purse. Last Thanksgiving at ma’s.

ROSE
Shit! My purse!

MARINER
Just in case! I worry about--

ROSE
Shut it! We gotta go back for it.

MARINER
What? No way! I’m taking you home. It’s my fault they went after you. I never thought they’d--

ROSE
(laughing)
You think they’re after you?

Mariner looks confused. DING - elevator doors open on 12.

Three THUGS are waiting for them. THUG 1 raises his GUN... Mariner SWINGS HIS OAR in an arc, catching the gun... BANG - shot goes high, GUN FLIES out of his hand... Mariner SIDE-KICKS him in the chest... Thug 1 FLIES back, knocking the others to the GROUND.

Rose has been frantically pressing the CLOSE DOOR button.

The thugs struggle to their feet.

THUG 2
(into radio)
We’ve got them on twelve.

THUGS 2 & 3 DRAW GUNS. BLAM BLAM BLAM. Rose and Mariner LEAP to the side... DOORS begin to CLOSE... Thug 2 LUNGES at the elevator BUTTON... Mariner’s OAR flashes through the closing doors... Thug 2 SCREAMS and CURSES... Doors close.

THUG
(muffled)
Go! Go! Down to eight!

Rose presses 11.

ROSE
We’ll take the stairs up. They won’t expect that.

MARINER
Because it’s stupid!

Rose raises an eyebrow at Mariner’s crazy outfit.

MARINER
It’s functional! ... And an homage.

Return ONLY valid JSON. No explanations or markdown fences.

SCENE EXCERPT:
INT. RUDDY & GREEN BUILDING - ELEVATOR

UB40's "I Can't Help Falling in Love With You" muzak.

ROSE (mid-30s) leans against the elevator wall, panting. She’s wearing a Tim Hortons uniform, her hair is a mess, and there’s blood spattered on her face.

She looks right, pants a few more times, then squints in disgust. She gingerly picks up a bloody scrap of something with hair on it. She snorts and drops it.

ROSE
Is that skull??

Next to her is Mariner, also panting, covered in far more blood. His face is broad, stoic, and frowning. He has gray-blue eyes and a thick, curly, beard barely streaked with gray. He wears a red knit cap and a small mask.

FULL-SCREEN SUPERIMPOSED TITLE CARD: "THE MARINER"

He blinks a few times as a drop of blood falls from his eyebrow. He looks toward her, then spits out some blood.

MARINER
Yeaaaaah...

He’s built like a pro-wrestler. Moss green SWEATER stretched over his huge frame, sleeves rolled showing heavy leather BRACERS adorned with anchors. His inner forearm has a classic heart-and-arrow TATTOO with "Dad" in the centre. Across his chest is a BANDOLIER of bright red 12-gauge shells, FISH HOOKS hanging from the bottom edge. Heavy rubberized BOOTS go past his knees. A CAPE of heavy FISHING NET edged with WEIGHTS hangs from his shoulders.

He holds a STOUT WOODEN OAR in both hands, edged with METAL and dripping with BLOOD. He shakes it to dislodge another GRISLY BIT which hits the ground with a wet plop.

ROSE
How the hell did you find me?

Mariner looks down and mumbles something.

ROSE
(annoyed)
What?

MARINER
AirTag.

ROSE
What??

MARINER
I stashed an AirTag in your purse. Last Thanksgiving at ma’s.

ROSE
Shit! My purse!

MARINER
Just in case! I worry about--

ROSE
Shut it! We gotta go back for it.

MARINER
What? No way! I’m taking you home. It’s my fault they went after you. I never thought they’d--

ROSE
(laughing)
You think they’re after you?

Mariner looks confused. DING - elevator doors open on 12.

Three THUGS are waiting for them. THUG 1 raises his GUN... Mariner SWINGS HIS OAR in an arc, catching the gun... BANG - shot goes high, GUN FLIES out of his hand... Mariner SIDE-KICKS him in the chest... Thug 1 FLIES back, knocking the others to the GROUND.

Rose has been frantically pressing the CLOSE DOOR button.

The thugs struggle to their feet.

THUG 2
(into radio)
We’ve got them on twelve.

THUGS 2 & 3 DRAW GUNS. BLAM BLAM BLAM. Rose and Mariner LEAP to the side... DOORS begin to CLOSE... Thug 2 LUNGES at the elevator BUTTON... Mariner’s OAR flashes through the closing doors... Thug 2 SCREAMS and CURSES... Doors close.

THUG
(muffled)
Go! Go! Down to eight!

Rose presses 11.

ROSE
We’ll take the stairs up. They won’t expect that.

MARINER
Because it’s stupid!

Rose raises an eyebrow at Mariner’s crazy outfit.

MARINER
It’s functional! ... And an homage.
==========

Return a JSON object with these fields:

  - description: 1-2 sentence description of the beat
  - confidence: float 0-1

- tone_shifts: Array of tone changes within the scene (e.g., ["tense to comic relief", "comic relief to conflict"])

- Infer location and time from context if not given as a heading
- Identify ALL characters who speak or are described, including those referred to by name
- Narrative beats should capture key story moments, not just action descriptions
- Be specific about tone — "dark comedy" is better than "mixed"

Return ONLY valid JSON. No explanations or markdown fences.

==========
SCENE EXCERPT:
INT. RUDDY & GREEN BUILDING - ELEVATOR

UB40's "I Can't Help Falling in Love With You" muzak.

ROSE (mid-30s) leans against the elevator wall, panting. She’s wearing a Tim Hortons uniform, her hair is a mess, and there’s blood spattered on her face.

She looks right, pants a few more times, then squints in disgust. She gingerly picks up a bloody scrap of something with hair on it. She snorts and drops it.

ROSE
Is that skull??

Next to her is Mariner, also panting, covered in far more blood. His face is broad, stoic, and frowning. He has gray-blue eyes and a thick, curly, beard barely streaked with gray. He wears a red knit cap and a small mask.

FULL-SCREEN SUPERIMPOSED TITLE CARD: "THE MARINER"

He blinks a few times as a drop of blood falls from his eyebrow. He looks toward her, then spits out some blood.

MARINER
Yeaaaaah...

He’s built like a pro-wrestler. Moss green SWEATER stretched over his huge frame, sleeves rolled showing heavy leather BRACERS adorned with anchors. His inner forearm has a classic heart-and-arrow TATTOO with "Dad" in the centre. Across his chest is a BANDOLIER of bright red 12-gauge shells, FISH HOOKS hanging from the bottom edge. Heavy rubberized BOOTS go past his knees. A CAPE of heavy FISHING NET edged with WEIGHTS hangs from his shoulders.

He holds a STOUT WOODEN OAR in both hands, edged with METAL and dripping with BLOOD. He shakes it to dislodge another GRISLY BIT which hits the ground with a wet plop.

ROSE
How the hell did you find me?

Mariner looks down and mumbles something.

ROSE
(annoyed)
What?

MARINER
AirTag.

ROSE
What??

MARINER
I stashed an AirTag in your purse. Last Thanksgiving at ma’s.

ROSE
Shit! My purse!

MARINER
Just in case! I worry about--

ROSE
Shut it! We gotta go back for it.

MARINER
What? No way! I’m taking you home. It’s my fault they went after you. I never thought they’d--

ROSE
(laughing)
You think they’re after you?

Mariner looks confused. DING - elevator doors open on 12.

Three THUGS are waiting for them. THUG 1 raises his GUN... Mariner SWINGS HIS OAR in an arc, catching the gun... BANG - shot goes high, GUN FLIES out of his hand... Mariner SIDE-KICKS him in the chest... Thug 1 FLIES back, knocking the others to the GROUND.

Rose has been frantically pressing the CLOSE DOOR button.

The thugs struggle to their feet.

THUG 2
(into radio)
We’ve got them on twelve.

THUGS 2 & 3 DRAW GUNS. BLAM BLAM BLAM. Rose and Mariner LEAP to the side... DOORS begin to CLOSE... Thug 2 LUNGES at the elevator BUTTON... Mariner’s OAR flashes through the closing doors... Thug 2 SCREAMS and CURSES... Doors close.

THUG
(muffled)
Go! Go! Down to eight!

Rose presses 11.

ROSE
We’ll take the stairs up. They won’t expect that.

MARINER
Because it’s stupid!

Rose raises an eyebrow at Mariner’s crazy outfit.

MARINER
It’s functional! ... And an homage.

You are a professional screenplay analyst. Extract scene-level metadata from the following scene excerpt.

Return a JSON object with these fields:
- heading: The scene heading in standard format (e.g., "INT. OFFICE - DAY"). Infer from context if not explicitly stated.
- location: The location name (without INT/EXT and time of day)
- time_of_day: e.g., "DAY", "NIGHT", "DAWN", "CONTINUOUS". Infer from context clues.
- int_ext: One of "INT", "EXT", or "INT/EXT"
- characters_present: Array of character names who appear or speak in this scene
- narrative_beats: Array of objects, each with:
  - beat_type: e.g., "character_introduction", "revelation", "conflict", "comic_relief", "thematic_statement", "action", "foreshadowing", "character_development"
  - description: 1-2 sentence description of the beat
  - confidence: float 0-1
- tone_mood: Overall tone/mood of the scene (e.g., "tense", "warm", "dark comedy")
- tone_shifts: Array of tone changes within the scene (e.g., ["tense to comic relief", "comic relief to conflict"])

Important:
- Infer location and time from context if not given as a heading
- Identify ALL characters who speak or are described, including those referred to by name
- Narrative beats should capture key story moments, not just action descriptions
- Be specific about tone — "dark comedy" is better than "mixed"

Return ONLY valid JSON. No explanations or markdown fences.

==========
SCENE EXCERPT:
INT. RUDDY & GREEN BUILDING - ELEVATOR

UB40's "I Can't Help Falling in Love With You" muzak.

ROSE (mid-30s) leans against the elevator wall, panting. She’s wearing a Tim Hortons uniform, her hair is a mess, and there’s blood spattered on her face.

She looks right, pants a few more times, then squints in disgust. She gingerly picks up a bloody scrap of something with hair on it. She snorts and drops it.

ROSE
Is that skull??

Next to her is Mariner, also panting, covered in far more blood. His face is broad, stoic, and frowning. He has gray-blue eyes and a thick, curly, beard barely streaked with gray. He wears a red knit cap and a small mask.

FULL-SCREEN SUPERIMPOSED TITLE CARD: "THE MARINER"

He blinks a few times as a drop of blood falls from his eyebrow. He looks toward her, then spits out some blood.

MARINER
Yeaaaaah...

He’s built like a pro-wrestler. Moss green SWEATER stretched over his huge frame, sleeves rolled showing heavy leather BRACERS adorned with anchors. His inner forearm has a classic heart-and-arrow TATTOO with "Dad" in the centre. Across his chest is a BANDOLIER of bright red 12-gauge shells, FISH HOOKS hanging from the bottom edge. Heavy rubberized BOOTS go past his knees. A CAPE of heavy FISHING NET edged with WEIGHTS hangs from his shoulders.

He holds a STOUT WOODEN OAR in both hands, edged with METAL and dripping with BLOOD. He shakes it to dislodge another GRISLY BIT which hits the ground with a wet plop.

ROSE
How the hell did you find me?

Mariner looks down and mumbles something.

ROSE
(annoyed)
What?

MARINER
AirTag.

ROSE
What??

MARINER
I stashed an AirTag in your purse. Last Thanksgiving at ma’s.

ROSE
Shit! My purse!

MARINER
Just in case! I worry about--

ROSE
Shut it! We gotta go back for it.

MARINER
What? No way! I’m taking you home. It’s my fault they went after you. I never thought they’d--

ROSE
(laughing)
You think they’re after you?

Mariner looks confused. DING - elevator doors open on 12.

Three THUGS are waiting for them. THUG 1 raises his GUN... Mariner SWINGS HIS OAR in an arc, catching the gun... BANG - shot goes high, GUN FLIES out of his hand... Mariner SIDE-KICKS him in the chest... Thug 1 FLIES back, knocking the others to the GROUND.

Rose has been frantically pressing the CLOSE DOOR button.

The thugs struggle to their feet.

THUG 2
(into radio)
We’ve got them on twelve.

THUGS 2 & 3 DRAW GUNS. BLAM BLAM BLAM. Rose and Mariner LEAP to the side... DOORS begin to CLOSE... Thug 2 LUNGES at the elevator BUTTON... Mariner’s OAR flashes through the closing doors... Thug 2 SCREAMS and CURSES... Doors close.

THUG
(muffled)
Go! Go! Down to eight!

Rose presses 11.

ROSE
We’ll take the stairs up. They won’t expect that.

MARINER
Because it’s stupid!

Rose raises an eyebrow at Mariner’s crazy outfit.

MARINER
It’s functional! ... And an homage.
==========

You are a professional screenplay analyst. Extract scene-level metadata from the following scene excerpt.

Return a JSON object with these fields:
- heading: The scene heading in standard format (e.g., "INT. OFFICE - DAY"). Infer from context if not explicitly stated.
- location: The location name (without INT/EXT and time of day)
- time_of_day: e.g., "DAY", "NIGHT", "DAWN", "CONTINUOUS". Infer from context clues.
- int_ext: One of "INT", "EXT", or "INT/EXT"
- characters_present: Array of character names who appear or speak in this scene
- narrative_beats: Array of objects, each with:
  - beat_type: e.g., "character_introduction", "revelation", "conflict", "comic_relief", "thematic_statement", "action", "foreshadowing", "character_development"
  - description: 1-2 sentence description of the beat
  - confidence: float 0-1
- tone_mood: Overall tone/mood of the scene (e.g., "tense", "warm", "dark comedy")
- tone_shifts: Array of tone changes within the scene (e.g., ["tense to comic relief", "comic relief to conflict"])

Important:
- Infer location and time from context if not given as a heading
- Identify ALL characters who speak or are described, including those referred to by name
- Narrative beats should capture key story moments, not just action descriptions
- Be specific about tone — "dark comedy" is better than "mixed"

Return ONLY valid JSON. No explanations or markdown fences.

==========
SCENE EXCERPT:
INT. RUDDY & GREEN BUILDING - ELEVATOR

UB40's "I Can't Help Falling in Love With You" muzak.

ROSE (mid-30s) leans against the elevator wall, panting. She’s wearing a Tim Hortons uniform, her hair is a mess, and there’s blood spattered on her face.

She looks right, pants a few more times, then squints in disgust. She gingerly picks up a bloody scrap of something with hair on it. She snorts and drops it.

ROSE
Is that skull??

Next to her is Mariner, also panting, covered in far more blood. His face is broad, stoic, and frowning. He has gray-blue eyes and a thick, curly, beard barely streaked with gray. He wears a red knit cap and a small mask.

FULL-SCREEN SUPERIMPOSED TITLE CARD: "THE MARINER"

He blinks a few times as a drop of blood falls from his eyebrow. He looks toward her, then spits out some blood.

MARINER
Yeaaaaah...

He’s built like a pro-wrestler. Moss green SWEATER stretched over his huge frame, sleeves rolled showing heavy leather BRACERS adorned with anchors. His inner forearm has a classic heart-and-arrow TATTOO with "Dad" in the centre. Across his chest is a BANDOLIER of bright red 12-gauge shells, FISH HOOKS hanging from the bottom edge. Heavy rubberized BOOTS go past his knees. A CAPE of heavy FISHING NET edged with WEIGHTS hangs from his shoulders.

He holds a STOUT WOODEN OAR in both hands, edged with METAL and dripping with BLOOD. He shakes it to dislodge another GRISLY BIT which hits the ground with a wet plop.

ROSE
How the hell did you find me?

Mariner looks down and mumbles something.

ROSE
(annoyed)
What?

MARINER
AirTag.

ROSE
What??

MARINER
I stashed an AirTag in your purse. Last Thanksgiving at ma’s.

ROSE
Shit! My purse!

MARINER
Just in case! I worry about--

ROSE
Shut it! We gotta go back for it.

MARINER
What? No way! I’m taking you home. It’s my fault they went after you. I never thought they’d--

ROSE
(laughing)
You think they’re after you?

Mariner looks confused. DING - elevator doors open on 12.

Three THUGS are waiting for them. THUG 1 raises his GUN... Mariner SWINGS HIS OAR in an arc, catching the gun... BANG - shot goes high, GUN FLIES out of his hand... Mariner SIDE-KICKS him in the chest... Thug 1 FLIES back, knocking the others to the GROUND.

Rose has been frantically pressing the CLOSE DOOR button.

The thugs struggle to their feet.

THUG 2
(into radio)
We’ve got them on twelve.

THUGS 2 & 3 DRAW GUNS. BLAM BLAM BLAM. Rose and Mariner LEAP to the side... DOORS begin to CLOSE... Thug 2 LUNGES at the elevator BUTTON... Mariner’s OAR flashes through the closing doors... Thug 2 SCREAMS and CURSES... Doors close.

THUG
(muffled)
Go! Go! Down to eight!

Rose presses 11.

ROSE
We’ll take the stairs up. They won’t expect that.

MARINER
Because it’s stupid!

Rose raises an eyebrow at Mariner’s crazy outfit.

MARINER
It’s functional! ... And an homage.
==========
